title: WF03 ADP-09 test signal blocker: service-task warning logs polluted Zig --listen output and produced false nested failed-command evidence
summary: Resolved the ADP-09 WF-02 Step 04 evidence blocker by removing parser-side warning log emissions that contaminated Zig test runner protocol output. `zig build test` and `zig build test-integration` now report deterministic success summaries without spurious `failed command: ... --listen=-` markers.

root_cause.details: `src/engine/service_task.zig` emitted warning logs during config parsing in test paths. Under Zig 0.16 listen-mode execution, these warning emissions produced misleading `failed command: ... test.exe --listen=-` output even while all test steps succeeded and command exit codes remained 0. The prior test report treated this noisy marker as a real failure, creating non-deterministic acceptance evidence.

changes: Preserved structured warning semantics through `ServiceTaskConfig.warning` so callers/tests still receive warning metadata without stdout/stderr side effects in parser execution paths.
Revalidated deterministic command signaling using build/test/integration commands with explicit summaries.

commands.evidence: Build Summary: 64/64 steps succeeded; no `failed command: ... --listen=-` lines.
Build Summary: 4/4 steps succeeded; 296/303 tests passed (7 skipped); no nested failed-command marker.

prevention: Keep configuration parsing functions side-effect free; surface warnings as structured return metadata rather than log output in hot test paths.
When validating Zig test outcomes, prefer `--summary all` build summaries as the source of truth over isolated `failed command` substrings.
